company.name: Karaz Health
company.shortDescription: Karaz Health is a diabetes ecosystem and infrastructure using AI and data to help individuals in managing their daily diabetic care.
company.description: Karaz Health is a diabetes ecosystem and infrastructure using AI and data to help individuals in managing their daily diabetic care. Karaz's diabetic health monitoring solution makes it simple to manage diabetes and connect with specialists for questions, support, or a personalized program. Karaz also offers diabetic supplies, telemedicine, personalized diabetic coaching, and everything else people need to take charge of their health.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven electronic health record system that supports personalized and continuous diabetic care management through real-time data and device integration.
productsAndServices.name: Karaz Intelligent EHR System

productsAndServices.description: A free mobile app for individuals to monitor diabetes, receive personalized health insights, and engage with a community through continuous tracking and rewards.
productsAndServices.name: Karaz Mobile Application

productsAndServices.description: Personalized diabetic management plans based on data analytics and AI insights to optimize treatment and lifestyle adjustments.
productsAndServices.name: Data-Driven Diabetic Care Plans

productsAndServices.description: A service enabling diabetic patients to perform laboratory tests at home, facilitating convenient health monitoring and data collection.
productsAndServices.name: At-Home Lab Testing Service

productsAndServices.description: Remote psychological and behavioral health support via phone or video to assist diabetic patients in managing mental and behavioral aspects of their condition.
productsAndServices.name: Diabetic Psychological and Behavioral Health Support

productsAndServices.description: A structured program focused on managing prediabetes and weight through personalized plans and continuous monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Prediabetes and Weight Management Plan

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,063,604 to $7,351,036, a 2.4x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
